method: Every reachable locale route was captured fresh from this source (strict live runtime, chrome, concurrency 1, batches of at most 25, a fresh local renderer per locale). A fresh body replaces the parent only where it differs from the parent canonically (normalise.py masks only runtime-volatile tokens: pseudo-class sheet counter, language-switcher id counter, random captcha operands, live IST clock, blank-line runs); every canonically unchanged body, and every uncaptured (redirected or retired) body, keeps the exact parent bytes and index row. Determinism: two full DE captures are canonically identical body for body, so each replaced body reflects changed sources/render inputs.

sourceForm.rule: A stored snapshot keeps SOURCE text/tags for the corrections design-view.tsx applies at serve time (reviewed heading outline; 2027 monsoon season; Room 209 area). The runtime had applied them before capture; source-form.mjs returns exactly those to source form and proves, per body, that the served composition is unchanged.

superseded.archive: ahv-locale-prerenders-train-n-20261015.tar.gz (uploaded, never pinned on a pushed commit): its bodies carried the runtime-applied corrections, which broke the source-snapshot tests; kept on the release, not deleted.

interactionOnlySources.policy: Not recaptured; validated as inert at every build by tools/verify-interaction-only-source.mjs.
